Class ControllerMyLessons

java.lang.Object
guiMyLessons.ControllerMyLessons
public class ControllerMyLessons extends Object

Title: ControllerMyLessons Class.

Description: The Java/FX-based My Lessons Page. This class provides the controller actions based on the contributor's use of the JavaFX GUI widgets defined by the View class: loading the contributor's lessons, searching them, opening one, adding a new one, and leaving the page. The class has been written assuming that the View or the Model are the only class methods that can invoke these methods. This is why each has been declared at "protected". Do not change any of these methods to public.

  • Method Details

    • refreshList

      protected static void refreshList()

      Method: refreshList()

      Description: Reloads the contributor's lessons from the database and shows them. It is called every time the page is displayed, so a lesson added, edited, or deleted on another page appears correctly when the contributor comes back.

    • performSearch

      protected static void performSearch()

      Method: performSearch()

      Description: Shows only the contributor's lessons that contain every keyword in the search field. The search runs on the lessons already loaded, so it never shows another contributor's lessons.

    • performClearSearch

      protected static void performClearSearch()

      Method: performClearSearch()

      Description: Empties the search field and shows all of the contributor's lessons again.

    • performOpenLesson

      protected static void performOpenLesson()

      Method: performOpenLesson()

      Description: Opens the selected lesson so the contributor can examine it more closely, see which fields are locked, and edit or delete it (Contributor story 2: "I can use that list to specify which lesson learned to examine more closely").

    • performAddLesson

      protected static void performAddLesson()

      Method: performAddLesson()

      Description: Goes to the Add Lesson page (Contributor story 1).
